## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature or behavior change
- [ ] Documentation, mocks or design system only
- [ ] Tests only
- [ ] Build, CI or tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] For behavior changes: the requirement (`docs/specs/`), detailed design (`docs/detailed-designs/`) and mock (`docs/mocks/`) exist and match this change
- [ ] Acceptance tests were written first and failed for the expected reason before the implementation
- [ ] Permissions are enforced on the server, with tests for who must **not** have access
- [ ] UI uses components from `frontend/projects/components/` and meets WCAG 2.2 AA
- [ ] Build, tests, lint and format checks pass locally
- [ ] Files follow the repository layout in `AGENTS.md`
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed

## Screenshots

For UI changes, add before and after screenshots (light and dark, phone and desktop).
